hero.titleLead: Nothing flies until something on the ground
hero.subtitle: Modular electrical, RF and functional test infrastructure. It shortens integration time, automates verification and extends the life of existing AIT facilities instead of replacing them.
hero.channelsHint: Select a channel to read its trace.

services.title: Capabilities
services.subtitle: Five channels, from the first drawing to the maintenance plan. Each one leaves behind the documents that make it verifiable.
services.sheetTitle: What we build, and what we hand over with it
services.sheetIntro: Design, construction and integration of electronic and electromechanical systems. Every delivery ships with its own file: test procedures, acceptance results, declaration of conformity. That file is what makes a supplier qualifiable.

progettazione.name: Design
progettazione.short: Systems built to run tests on assemblies of varying complexity.
progettazione.description: Electrical and electromechanical systems designed to run tests on assemblies of varying complexity and nature, from the preliminary design submitted at proposal stage through to the user manual.

integrazione.name: Integration
integrazione.short: Turnkey systems and installations for Space, Defence, Industrial and Civil.
integrazione.description: Turnkey systems and installations across Space, Defence, Industrial and Civil programmes, including data acquisition and processing systems.

installazione.name: Installation
installazione.short: Technological, electrical, radiocommunication and radio-link installations.
installazione.description: Technological and electrical installations, radiocommunication systems and radio links: control panels, transformer substations, earthing, network cabling and optical fibre.

collaudo.name: Test & certification
collaudo.short: Acceptance testing and certification against the applicable standards.
collaudo.description: Documentation, acceptance testing and certification against the applicable standards, including the AIV plan with its test cases and test procedures, and CE marking on complete systems.

manutenzione.name: Maintenance
manutenzione.short: Preventive and corrective plans, with integrated logistic support.
manutenzione.description: Planning, scheduling and execution of preventive and corrective maintenance on delivered systems, with integrated logistic support.

sectors.title: Where the systems end up

cta.title: Tell us what you need to verify
cta.body: Send us the assembly, the interface or the procedure that is holding up integration. We will tell you whether it is a retrofit, a module or a full system — and what it takes.
cta.note: Technical detail is shared after NDA and export-control assessment.
